name: branch
description: One high-importance parent with children vs. an unrelated low-importance parent whose children look more urgent on their own features. Proves propagation changes the outcome, not just that it runs.

nodes.label: Child of the strategic goal, low own urgency
Another child of the strategic goal, even lower own urgency
Child of the routine goal, looks urgent on its own
Another child of the routine goal

notes: task_low_1/2 have higher own importance (0.7-0.8) than task_high_1/2 (0.2-0.3), but must still rank below them once the parent goal's importance is applied -- that across-group order is the fixture's real claim, and it holds under any reasonable combination formula. The within-group order (task_high_1 over task_high_2, task_low_1 over task_low_2) is weaker: it only follows for formulas where a task's own importance still matters once combined with its parent's, e.g. additive/weighted-sum formulas. It is not guaranteed under a pure max-style formula, where task_high_1 and task_high_2 can legitimately tie.
